verdict.rationale: Codex's docs appear to be served as raw Markdown on learn.chatgpt.com (pages such as /docs/codex/cli.md and /docs/extend/mcp.md are cited directly), which gives agents a machine-readable doc format to read. However, probes found no llms.txt at platform.openai.com/llms.txt and no Markdown version of the main Codex docs page (/docs/codex.md), both returning HTTP 404. Agent-oriented docs are therefore only implied by the .md URLs, not documented as a feature. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt index, a documented agent-facing docs offering, Markdown coverage of the main platform Codex docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Inspect code, make changes, run commands, and automate repeatable work without leaving your terminal.
